title: Hubble Space Telescope
note: Hubble as it is now, after Servicing Mission 4 (May 2009): SA3 rigid arrays, Soft Capture Mechanism on the aft bulkhead, NOBL covers on the bay doors. instruments.note: Axial SIs run from the 116.18 label to the 202.68 label (86.5 in, the box's 86.6). Estimated: each axial box sits in its quadrant with its outer face at the 40.00 dimension; STIS and NICMOS are on +V2, ACS and COS (in COSTAR's bay) on -V2 (glossary); which of each pair is on +V3 is estimated; radial modules from STA 209 (just forward of the deck) with their inner tips 7 in off the axis, at the edge of the focal plane's 14 arcmin FGS field; which of +-V2 is FGS1; the pentagonal outline (Figure 4-15); radial SI axes (21 in along V1, the size of the FGS's 0.5 m). The deck is a square frame with a cross, after Figure 4-14; bipods estimated.

open_questions: SA3: where the wing's 7.1 m starts (mast vs panels), mast length, and whether SA3 uses the original pivot at STA 320. Fit from photos.
Handrail cross-section and standoff height: not found; measure from photos against known sizes.
HGA boom length: the drawing labels the dish at 232.30 in from the axis, but scaling the drawing by the door gives about 185 in, and s125e012031 (unfitted) suggests about 4.5 m; kept the label.
Instruments: which of each axial pair is on +V3 (STIS/NICMOS on +V2, ACS/COS on -V2 per the NASA glossary), and which of the +-V2 radial bays is FGS1. Placed by estimate.
